Our story

A small room built around one big fire

Inês grew up between her grandmother's olive grove and a village bakery; Tomás spent a decade cooking in busy city kitchens. In 2014 they opened a 38-seat dining room in Alfama with a single idea: cook everything over wood, and keep it simple.

Every morning the oven is lit with prunings from the family grove. By evening it is roaring, ready for bread, whole fish, charred greens and the slow-roasted lamb our regulars ask for by name.

  • 38seats around the hearth
  • 12farms we cook with
  • 140+natural wines

— Inês & Tomás, founders
